verdict.rationale: Kick documents extensive AI-agent access via MCP connectors (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, custom AI tools) and a CLI, allowing an AI-native user to query, update, and automate bookkeeping data with documented connection details (kick-docs-24–29). However, a direct probe confirms no conventional public REST/OpenAPI API exists (kick-probe-2, all endpoints 404), so 'documented public API' is satisfied only via the MCP/CLI layer rather than a traditional API surface. missing for 10: a first-party OpenAPI/REST API spec, independent third-party corroboration of MCP reliability.
